products.text:
Type: framed black and white photo print
Use: wall decoration; living room, bedroom, home office, above a sofa or desk
Style: modern, industrial, minimalist
Materials: photographic print, white mat, black wood frame
Colors: black, white, soft grey
Shape: landscape rectangle, wide white mat, slim black frame, bridge tower and suspension cables, small and light
Feel: urban, graphic, crisp
Goes with: white or grey walls, black metal, chrome accents; modern, industrial or urban loft rooms

Type: copper-toned forest canvas print
Use: wall decoration; living room, bedroom, dining room, above a sofa or bed
Style: contemporary, glam, Scandinavian
Materials: canvas print with metallic copper finish, unframed
Colors: copper, warm white, light grey
Shape: large landscape rectangle, frameless gallery canvas, row of tall vertical tree trunks, airy composition, light visual weight
Feel: warm, serene, airy, natural
Goes with: white walls, copper or brass accents, light wood, blush tones; contemporary or glam rooms

Type: ocean waves canvas print
Use: wall decoration; living room, bedroom, home office, above a sofa or bed
Style: coastal, contemporary, modern
Materials: printed canvas, unframed
Colors: deep navy blue, white, teal blue
Shape: large landscape rectangle, frameless canvas, close-up of foamy surf, all-over abstract texture, bold visual weight
Feel: fresh, dynamic, calming
Goes with: white walls, navy and sand tones, light wood, rattan; coastal or modern rooms

Type: framed whale illustration print
Use: wall decoration; living room, bedroom, home office, hallway
Style: coastal, rustic, traditional
Materials: printed illustration, grey wood frame with grain texture
Colors: white, slate blue, grey, beige
Shape: large portrait rectangle, eight whales stacked horizontally, white background, medium grey frame, substantial size
Feel: nautical, calm, curious
Goes with: white or blue-grey walls, weathered wood, navy textiles; coastal or farmhouse rooms

Type: vintage wine list typography print
Use: wall decoration; dining room, living room, near a bar cart
Style: farmhouse, traditional, retro
Materials: printed linen-texture panel, off-white wood frame
Colors: black, off-white, cream
Shape: tall portrait rectangle, stacked bold uppercase wine names, ornamental crest bands top and bottom, distressed print, wide pale frame
Feel: nostalgic, convivial, graphic
Goes with: dark wood, white walls, black iron, wine racks; farmhouse, bistro or traditional dining rooms

Type: black and white city skyline canvas
Use: wall decoration; living room, bedroom, home office, above a sofa or desk
Style: modern, contemporary, industrial
Materials: printed canvas, unframed
Colors: white, grey, black
Shape: long panoramic rectangle, dense downtown towers, hillside behind, soft sun flare bokeh circles, slim and horizontal
Feel: urban, bright, dreamy
Goes with: grey or white walls, chrome, black metal, glass; modern or urban loft rooms

Type: framed aerial snowy road print
Use: wall decoration; living room, bedroom, home office
Style: modern, Scandinavian, minimalist
Materials: photographic print, white mat, brushed silver frame
Colors: white, dark green-grey, black, silver
Shape: landscape rectangle, wide white mat, aerial view of curving road through snowy pine forest, slim metallic frame, medium size
Feel: quiet, crisp, wintry
Goes with: white or grey walls, light wood, chrome accents; Scandinavian or modern rooms

Type: framed abstract geode print
Use: wall decoration; living room, bedroom, home office, gallery wall
Style: contemporary, modern, coastal
Materials: printed watercolor-style artwork, thin silver frame
Colors: light blue, navy, white, pale aqua
Shape: square, concentric watercolor rings radiating from a crystal center, slim floating frame, compact
Feel: calm, fresh, soft
Goes with: white walls, blue textiles, silver or chrome accents; contemporary or coastal rooms

Type: round mirror in square wood frame
Use: reflecting light, wall decoration; living room, bedroom, entryway, above a console
Style: rustic, industrial, farmhouse
Materials: plank wood panel, dark metal frame and crossbars, mirror glass
Colors: warm dark brown wood, gunmetal grey, silver
Shape: square plank backing, metal border, circular mirror centered, crossbars dividing into quadrants, compact and solid
Feel: warm, sturdy, crafted
Goes with: reclaimed wood, black iron, leather, warm neutrals; rustic, industrial or farmhouse rooms

Type: star-shaped gold wall mirror
Use: reflecting light, wall decoration; living room, bedroom, entryway
Style: glam, bohemian, art deco
Materials: gold-finish metal wire frame, mirror glass
Colors: gold, silver
Shape: round mirror within a six-pointed open wire star outline, thin lines, light and airy, medium size
Feel: playful, elegant, bright
Goes with: white or blush walls, velvet, brass accents; glam, boho or eclectic rooms
